_note: Old citations of the lesson standard (version 1, now docs/lesson-standard/history-v1.md) mapped to the sections of docs/lesson-standard.md (version 2). Apply longest key first, so '26.1.2' is matched before '26.1' and 'lesson standard 26.10, step 4' before '26.10'. Rewrite a 'section N' key only where the citation names the lesson standard (many 'section 4.1', 'section 6', 'section 8' citations point at docs/learning-science.md or other docs and must be left alone). Never rewrite numbers that are not citations ($26.10, 26.17, 26.85, 26.18, 26.1749), version names ('lesson standard 1', 'standard 2', the field standard: 2), or the history entries of subject records. A value of 'history' means the section is retired: cite it as docs/lesson-standard/history-v1.md, section N, or drop the citation. A value '3 to 9' marks a citation of the whole practice engine or of the as-built reports, whose decisions are folded through sections 3 to 9; pick the narrower section from the context where one fits.
